content: 1. Adolescents should engage in at least 60 minutes of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity every day to promote overall health and well-being. 2. Monitoring blood glucose levels before, during, and after exercise is essential to ensure proper glycemic control and to prevent complications. 3. Providing education on glycemic targets and management strategies related to physical activity is critical for both young individuals and their caregivers to optimize safety and outcomes. 4. It is important to remain vigilant about the risk of hypoglycemia, particularly in the post-exercise period, as this is a time of increased vulnerability.
